subject: StratusOps onboarding: party matrix + MSA redline initiation
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T16:12:00Z
Subject: StratusOps onboarding: party matrix + MSA redline initiation

Hi Marissa / Kim,

We're kicking off contracting for StratusOps (new logo, mid-market). They shared an initial Order Form and their MSA; attaching both and a simple party contact matrix I started. Primary ask from the sales side: get a first-pass redline on the MSA focused on data handling, SLA, and IP exhibits, and a clean Order Form that maps to our billing and usage SKU terms.

Quick background: StratusOps will ingest logs and vectors from customer apps; they want a 7-day KV cache retention, and are asking for a 99.9% p99 latency SLA on dedicated workload (they'll likely go Dedicated). Procurement contact is Priya Anand; legal counsel is external (copied below).

Things I included / requests:
- Party contact matrix (attached): who signs, billing contact, technical contact. Please confirm signatory name and whether we need an ADDL entity on the signature block.
- MSA: please highlight high-priority concerns (data retention, audit logs, indemnity limits, export controls).
- Order Form: ensure billing cadence maps to our standard monthly usage + reserved capacity addendum.

Timing: customer is aiming to finalize commercial terms by 7/10. Can we get a first redline + comment memo by EOD 7/2? If that's tight, call out what needs more time.

Attachments: StratusOps_OrderForm_v1.docx; StratusOps_MSA_Draft.docx; party-contact-matrix.xlsx

Thanks — Dylan
--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-01T18:35:00Z
Subject: Re: StratusOps onboarding: party matrix + MSA redline initiation

Thanks Dylan — got it. I'll take point on MSA redlines; Kim, looping you for legal signoff and export control review.

Initial read (high level):
- Data retention / KV cache: 7 days is OK for hosted but we need to ensure there's an explicit clause about customer data and cache eviction for Dedicated. Also call out that cache TTLs can be configurable per-customer and are not a guarantee unless in Order Form.
- SLA: their 99.9% p99 request is aggressive for some models; need to know target model families and expected VRU to size. Marissa to sync with infra if required.
- Liability / indemnity: they have a mutual indemnity but limits are asymmetric; recommend proposing a $5M cap (we can discuss).

I can produce a redline with comments by EOD 7/2 but would like the following clarified before finalizing:
1) Exact billing SKU names/tiers for Reserved vs. Burst — Dylan, can you confirm the SKU IDs?
2) Final signatory entity name (the matrix has "StratusOps, Inc.") — confirm whether they have a subsidiary that needs to be added.

I'll attach a brief comment memo with the redline.

-Marissa
--
Marissa Cole
Senior Contracts Manager | Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@stratusops.io>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Anand <priya.anand@stratusops.io>
Cc: Outside Counsel <counsel@lawfirmexample.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T02:12:00Z
Subject: Re: StratusOps onboarding: party matrix + MSA redline initiation

Hi Dylan — thanks for sending. Confirming a couple of items from our side:
- Signatory: StratusOps, Inc. (no extra subsidiaries).
- Billing: default is monthly invoicing; we expect to reserve 2x baseline capacity in month 1 and then adjust. I'll put SKU IDs in a follow-up.

Attaching the Order Form and MSA we discussed (same as you have attached, but I added a cover note). We've also filled the party contact matrix and added our CTO as technical contact.

On the SLA: we can be flexible on model families used; our SRE can align on target latency windows after you confirm the serving topology. For now, treat 99.9% p99 as a commercial ask, not a hard technical requirement.

Attachments: StratusOps_OrderForm_v1.docx (attached), StratusOps_MSA_Draft.docx (attached), completed-party-contact-matrix.xlsx (attached)

Thanks — Ethan
--

Head of Platform | StratusOps

Appreciate the quick turnaround all. Marissa — if you can get the redline and the 1-page comment memo by 7/06 EOD that would move the needle for procurement. Priyom and I will confirm SKU IDs first thing tomorrow and flag any model family constraints to infra.

Kim — can you also check whether the customer-requested 7-day KV retention has any implications for our audit-log retention policy? If there's an exception needed, flag it in the memo.

Next steps summary:
- Sales (Dylan/Priyom): confirm SKU IDs and share expected Reserved capacity numbers (by 7/04).
- Contracts (Marissa): deliver redline + comment memo (by 7/06).
- Legal (Kim): export controls and audit-log impact check (by 7/06).
- Customer (Ethan/Priya): confirm billing cadence and signatory (ack received).

I'll update the HubSpot deal and drop the redline when it lands.

Cheers — Dylan
